segments.text: Anna has a bitcoin trade open on Perpl, a trading app.
Her friend Bo texts: sell at eighty-four thousand.
She has to type it in herself, or forgets.
And the tips Bo sends cost him nothing when they are wrong.
frens puts your friends' picks on your chart, with their money behind them.
Beau drags his price onto Anna's trade.
Anna taps accept once, and it becomes a real sell order on Perpl, with Beau's name on it.
Anna puts in two dollars, Beau's reward if he's right.
Bo puts in two dollars behind his pick.
If bitcoin gets there before the deadline, Bo takes all four.
If not, Anna gets all four back.
Every pick Bo makes is scored in public: how many came true, and what he earned.
I built frens on Perpl, the busiest trading app on Monad, the blockchain it runs on.
Traders are already asking for this.
Perpl's Telegram alone has over nine thousand members.
Your friends' picks, on your chart, with their money behind them.
